entities.name: Armando Amaral Dos Santos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Armando Amaral dos Santos was an Angolan clergyman and bishop for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Benguela. He became ordained in 1956. He was appointed bishop in 1970. He died on 14 October 1973, at the age of 44.
